description: This file contains a C# class definition for DurableValueTestGrain, a test grain implementing the ITestDurableGrainInterface, which interacts with durable key-value storage for testing purposes.

classes.name: DurableValueTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class that manages durable key-value pairs for name and counter, with methods to set and retrieve these values along with its activation ID.

methods.name: SetValues
methods.description: Sets the 'name' and 'counter' values in durable storage.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the activation ID of the grain instance.
